Infinity Journeys  — a transport and journey-focused project exploring the experience of moving by aircraft, train, ferry, road and other forms of transport. Plane Spotters Central  — a commercial aviation media channel focused on aircraft, airports, aviation economics and plane spotting. Elara & Amara  — an emerging virtual-influencer and AI storytelling project combining digital personalities, travel, lifestyle, STEM and visual storytelling. Portfolio 2: Science, Nature & Food Computing Media This portfolio combines science communication, nature, technology and educational media. Button Botany  — a botany and horticulture-focused digital project exploring plants, gardens, botanical discovery and the natural world. Food Computing Academy (FCA)  — FSC's education and training initiative focused on food computing, artificial intelligence, data science, digital transformation, computational approaches to food science and related technologies. You may be involved in: Developing and producing educational YouTube videos Creating YouTube Shorts and other short-form content Turning technical concepts into accessible visual content Researching topics for videos and social posts Developing infographics and educational graphics Editing video and audio Creating thumbnails and other visual assets Managing content calendars Repurposing YouTube content for LinkedIn, Instagram and other platforms Using AI tools to support content development and production Tracking content performance and audience engagement Exploring ways to build FCA's online educational community This portfolio would particularly suit someone studying or interested in  food science/technology, computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, biology, biotechnology, botany, horticulture, agricultural science, environmental science or science communication . Depending on your portfolio, you could gain experience in: YouTube channel development Multimedia production Short-form video Social-media strategy Digital storytelling AI-generated media Virtual influencers Science communication Educational content Travel and aviation media Personal and organisational branding Audience development Content analytics Cross-platform content strategy Building digital brands from the ground up You will also have the opportunity to build a  real portfolio of published work  that you can use in future employment, study or entrepreneurial activities. This opportunity may suit: University students Recent graduates Students seeking practical experience alongside their studies People developing a career in digital media or content creation Science or technology students interested in communication Creative students interested in emerging technologies Aspiring YouTubers or content creators People interested in travel, aviation, botany or food technology People interested in AI and the future of digital media We welcome applicants from a range of academic and professional backgrounds. Travel, Aviation & Digital Storytelling Wanderverse | Infinity Journeys | Plane Spotters Central | Elara & Amara 2. Science, Nature & Food Computing Media Button Botany | Food Computing Academy | FCA YouTube 3. Open to either You can also nominate  specific projects  that particularly interest you. Show us what you can create. Experiment-oriented  — you're comfortable trying new platforms, formats and AI tools. Reliable  — you understand that consistent publishing matters. Collaborative  — you can work with people from different backgrounds and contribute ideas. Interested in building something  — rather than simply completing assigned tasks. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies. Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter, ideally hiring across multiple functions/locales. Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them). Fluent in English (C1 minimum). Other languages, esp. German, a plus. Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support. Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with. The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
